PLAN "General Strength for Post-L4-L5 Herniation (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength safely post-disc herniation"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation & Movement Quality" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body & Core Stability":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          single_leg_glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          bird_dog 5m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body & Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          airbike 7m
        main straight_sets:
          chest_press_machine 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          cable_face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_camel 5m
